name: Burning Blood (quest item)
summary: In Duskwood, Nightbane worgen blood draws Grimand Elmore's interest. He needs twenty vials for experiments in smithing.

sections.title: A Volatile Reagent
sections.body: Nightbane worgen prowl Duskwood in a strange fury. Their blood burns with real heat. It can be drawn from worgen haunting the timberlands and Roland's Doom. Armorers seek its heat to temper resilient plate.

sections.title: Elmore's Experiment
sections.body:
Grimand Elmore is an armorer in Stormwind's Dwarven District. He wants to test smithing methods devised by his former student Furen Longbeard.

For the experiment, Elmore needs Burning Blood and a dense burning rock held by the worgen chieftain Gutspill. Bring him the bubbling fluid, and he promises sturdy warrior armor from his forge.

faq.answer: Nightbane worgen in Duskwood have hot blood. Grimand Elmore needs it for smithing experiments.

faq.q: Where does Burning Blood come from?
faq.answer: Burning Blood comes from Nightbane worgen in Duskwood, especially those around Roland's Doom.

faq.q: Why does Grimand Elmore need it?
faq.answer: Grimand Elmore needs Burning Blood to test smithing methods developed by Furen Longbeard. With a burning rock, he plans to forge protective mail for a warrior.

faq.q: Why is the blood of the Nightbane burning?
aliases: why do worgen have burning blood
faq.answer: Nightbane are unnatural fiends summoned by dark, chaotic magic. The curse in their blood gives it a fierce, unnatural heat.

angles.text: Grimand Elmore uses Burning Blood to test smithing methods. He promises durable plate armor to warriors who bring it to him.
Smiths can use unusual materials like burning worgen blood to quench and temper heavy metals at extreme heat.
